howto.what: 当你问 Google ADK 怎么用时,Claude 会先理清你的需求和环境,再建议用单个还是多个智能体,并给出分步实施计划和验证步骤,而不是只给代码片段。
howto.when: 当你提到 Google ADK、Agent Development Kit 等词,或问智能体架构选择时,自动触发。

say.text: 我想用 Google ADK 做一个客服机器人,该怎么设计?
say.note: Claude 会先确认需求,再给架构和实施计划。

say.text: 应该用单个智能体还是多智能体编排?
say.note: Claude 会分析权衡并给出推荐。

say.text: 用 Google ADK 部署后怎么验证?
say.note: Claude 会提供验证清单和健康检查步骤。

howto.what_en: When you ask about using Google ADK, Claude clarifies your needs and environment, suggests single vs multi-agent, and provides a step-by-step implementation plan and verification steps, rather than just code snippets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Google ADK, Agent Development Kit, or ask about agent architecture choices.

say_en.text: I want to build a customer service bot with Google ADK. How should I design it?
say_en.note: Claude will clarify requirements and provide an architecture and plan.

say_en.text: Should this be a single agent or a multi-agent orchestrator?
say_en.note: Claude will compare tradeoffs and recommend a structure.

say_en.text: How do I verify a Google ADK deployment?
say_en.note: Claude will give a validation checklist and health checks.
